# Version And Audit History

## Caption

If agents can run it, teams need to know who owns it, what changed, and which version people installed. Intertool keeps capability history attached to every skill, prompt, MCP server, and internal tool.

#DevEx #AIOps #AIGovernance #DeveloperTools #PlatformEngineering #SoftwareEngineering #Intertool

## Alt Text

1. Agent capabilities change. History should not disappear. Prompts, skills, tools, and MCP servers need traceability.
2. Attach ownership to every artifact. Owner, status, version, source, and files travel together.
3. Know what changed before people install it. Version notes make agent behavior easier to explain later.
4. Approvals become events, not memories. Review and rollout decisions stay visible to platform teams.
5. Diff versions before the next rollout. Treat agent capabilities like operational software.
6. Give every capability a paper trail. Intertool keeps history close to what developers install.
